thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for inference-api — latency.p99 > 1200ms in us-west-2. Trigger: PD-PAGER-9087.

maria_dev: seeing the alert, checking dashboards now https://dash.redwood.example/services/inference-api/latency?region=us-west-2

ashley_oncall: acked. I'm the on-call for the next 30m, taking lead :handshake:

ashley_oncall: quick numbers from the dashboard: p95 ~ 320ms, p99 ~ 1420ms, request rate steady at 180 rps. No deploys in last 15m.

maria_dev: thanks. dustin, any recent autoscaler or preemptions in that region?

dustin_sre: checking infra… no recent instance terminations in us-west-2. Autoscaler shows a brief cooldown spike 2m ago but no scale-up. GPU queue length increased (burst of small requests).

dustin_sre: logs (tail):
```
[2026-03-18T12:34:10Z] kv-cache: miss rate 31%
[2026-03-18T12:34:11Z] sidecar-batcher: batch_size avg 1.4 -> higher CPU overhead
[2026-03-18T12:34:12Z] tokenizer: backlog=130 requests
```

ashley_oncall: kv-cache miss ups could explain tail. Maria — can you check model fallback routing? Maybe a heavier model got routed.

maria_dev: on it — checking router logs.

maria_dev: router shows 18% of requests routed to model-4-large (quantized false) since 12:29 UTC, likely from canary rewrite rule.

ashley_oncall: ok that's our lead. Action plan: 1) revert rewrite rule that routes to model-4-large 2) warm KV cache / restart sidecar batching 3) monitor p99 for 10m.

ashley_oncall: Maria — can you revert the routing change? If you need approval ping product.

maria_dev: rolling back the routing rule now (rb: router/2026-03-18-12:36). Command: `routectl rollback router/us-west-2 --id router/2026-03-18-12:29`

dustin_sre: warming caches: kicking kv-cache warmup job for hot prefixes and increasing sidecar batch window slightly: `kubectl exec -n inference deploy/cache-warmup -- run --hotkeys-file /tmp/hot.txt`

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: routectl: rollback accepted, new traffic plan will take ~30s to propagate.

ashley_oncall: good. Eva — can you draft short customer note if we need to? Any immediate customer errors?

eva_support: no increase in 5xxs so far, customers seeing latency only. I'll prep a short advisory template in #support-ops and stand by.

maria_dev: rollback completed, router logs show traffic to model-4-large dropped to <1% at 12:37:05 UTC.

ashley_oncall: monitoring — watch p99 and KV hit-rate.

dustin_sre: KV hit-rate jumped from 69% -> 88% after warmup job. Sidecar batch_size avg moved to 2.6.

maria_dev: current numbers: p95 310ms, p99 730ms, request rate stable.

ashley_oncall: much better. Leaving the incident in observe state for now. If p99 drops below 800ms for 10m we close.

incident-bot: Incident PD-PAGER-9087 updated: status=investigating -> monitoring.

ashley_oncall: cleanup tasks: create internal follow-up ticket (SRE-4567) to add a guardrail preventing non-quantized model from getting traffic without capacity check. Maria + Dustin assigned.

maria_dev: created SRE-4567 with notes and links to replay logs.

ashley_oncall: handoff: I'm on-call for 20 more minutes then will hand to maria_dev for watch. If anything flares up after I drop I'll page rotation.

maria_dev: I'll take watch after 13:00 UTC.

eva_support: posting advisory draft to #support-ops now. Template: short note explaining transient latency, root cause (routing to heavier model), mitigation (rollback), no data loss, monitoring.

ashley_oncall: thanks everyone. Closing PD alert if no regression in 10m. :thumbsup:
